mitigation_descriptions: Restrict sudo access and configure the sudoers file to require passwords and minimize command elevation privileges.
Review and manage user account privileges to ensure the principle of least privilege is applied to user jhall.
Audit sudo configuration files (/etc/sudoers and /etc/sudoers.d/) and monitor auditd/auth logs for unauthorized privilege escalation.
reasoning: The adversarial reviewer confirmed privilege escalation activity (T1548.003 - Sudo and Sudo Caching) by user jhall on host intranet-server (10.143.2.4) across multiple security rules. Immediate containment is required to isolate the host and revoke compromised or unauthorized sudo privileges.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the affected host intranet-server (10.143.2.4) from the network to prevent lateral movement. 2. Suspend or revoke sudo permissions and active sessions for user account jhall. 3. Inspect /etc/sudoers and /etc/sudoers.d/ configuration files for unauthorized modifications or overly permissive rules. 4. Review audit and authentication logs on agent ID 10 to identify all commands executed with elevated privileges. 5. Reset credentials for user jhall and verify the integrity of system binaries and services on intranet-server.
